children: Kenvue entered into a Third Supplemental Indenture to amend its 2023 base indenture and related supplements, facilitating Kimberly-Clark's exchange offers for up to $7.0 billion of existing Kenvue notes. The amendments remove most restrictive covenants, certain events of default (other than payment), the SEC reporting covenant, and some merger and asset transfer restrictions. The supplemental indenture was signed on October 9, 2026 and becomes operative for each note series upon settlement of the related exchange offer, expected around the Kimberly-Clark acquisition closing.
: Third Supplemental Indenture amending existing debt indenture and notes covenants
: Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas, as trustee
: Facilitate Kimberly-Clark note exchange and acquisition closing
